title: Esketamine nasal spray vs placebo for MADRS change in treatment-resistant depression
question: In adults with treatment-resistant depression, does intranasal esketamine added to an oral antidepressant reduce the MADRS depression score versus placebo added to an oral antidepressant? (Randomized double-blind trials; mean difference in MADRS points at the ~4-week induction endpoint.)
pubmed_queries: esketamine nasal spray treatment-resistant depression randomized double-blind MADRS
"esketamine"[Title] AND "treatment-resistant depression" AND placebo AND randomized
intranasal esketamine oral antidepressant treatment resistant depression randomized

primary_outcome.name: Observed-case Day-28 raw change-score MADRS MD

combine_eligible_doses.basis: Cochrane Handbook 6.5.2.10 / 23.3.4: combine the eligible intranasal esketamine dose arms into one arm against the SHARED placebo, counted once
combine_eligible_doses.registration: Declared 2026-09-27 (external review f5b8f4cb), AFTER registration -- NOT demonstrably prospective. The TRANSFORM-1 publication calls the dose combination post hoc.

primary.population: observed at Day 28 within the full analysis set
primary.protocol_quote: Per-arm change-from-baseline mean and standard deviation are taken verbatim from the trial's primary report or its structured ClinicalTrials.gov posted results (paramType MEAN with a Standard-Deviation dispersion), never a least-squares mean with a standard error

sensitivity.rule: reported adjusted (LS-mean) difference with an ESTABLISHED SE: stated, or from a standard fixed-level two-sided CI; stage-weighted / flexible CIs refused

NCT02417064.source: EMA assessment footnote cited by the external review f5b8f4cb (2026-09-27); the footnote itself is NOT held

comparator_outcomes.name: Observed-case Day-28 raw change-score MADRS MD

eligibility_summary: Double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs in adults with treatment-resistant depression where intranasal esketamine plus an oral antidepressant is compared with intranasal placebo plus an oral antidepressant. Eligibility is on P/I/C/design only; outcome reporting is extraction status. Fixed-dose multi-arm trials without a pre-specified dose comparison are refused by the multi-arm guard.
